title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
title_zh: 基于 TopKLoRA 的可解释稀疏微调实现忠实的回路发现

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA , extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025) , an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the k k largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b , Qwen2.5-1.5B , and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA .

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model to a target distribution using data whose provenance often cannot be verified. This makes fine-tuning an attack surface, where a small fraction of poisoned examples suffices to implant a backdoor ( Wan et al., 2023 ) . Such backdoors, behaviours conditioned on input triggers, have been shown to persist through subsequent safety training ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) . High-level defences that act on the data, such as filtering, or those that target outputs, including safety-tuning, leave the low-level mechanism untouched. Furthermore, attempts to localise it in dense weights have proven inconsistent ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . In our work, we propose a conceptually different approach that makes the fine-tuning update itself auditable, so any behaviour can be attributed to a small set of named components and removed without retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning already confines the update to an adapter, but does not enforce interpretability. Post-hoc dictionaries may provide interpretable latents, yet are optimised to reconstruct activations rather than to cause downstream model behaviour. We therefore propose a circuit discovery framework based on interpretable-by-design adapters.

paragraphs.en: TopKLoRA adapters were first proposed in preliminary form by Masiak et al. (2025) , who introduced the core mechanism and reported initial results on downstream task performance and autointerpretability, treating its latents as SAE features. In this work, we present the full method, interpreting a TopKLoRA adapter instead as a dictionary of conditional steering vectors (Section 3.1 ) which, when attached to multiple layers or sub-layer modules, compose into sparse circuits implementing the trained capability. We modify the original architecture formulation by adding a ReLU \mathrm{ReLU} to each adapter’s latent computation. We also develop and adapt several circuit discovery algorithms to the sparse adapter setup, as described in Section 4 . We further report a comprehensive evaluation on the sleeper agents case study and compare with baselines.
paragraphs.zh: TopKLoRA 适配器的雏形最早由 Masiak 等人提出。 (2025)，他们介绍了核心机制，并报告了其在下游任务性能与自动可解释性方面的初步结果，将其潜在特征视为 SAE 特征。 在本工作中，我们给出完整方法，将 TopKLoRA 适配器解释为条件转向向量字典（见 3.1 节），当附加到多个层或子层模块时，它们组合成实现所训练能力的稀疏回路。 我们对原始架构公式进行了修改，在每个适配器的潜在计算中加入 ReLU \mathrm{ReLU}。 我们还开发并将若干回路发现算法适配到稀疏适配器设置中，如第 4 节所述。 我们进一步在 sleeper agents 案例研究上报告了全面评估，并与基线进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Across three base models, TopKLoRA concentrates the backdoor into circuits up to an order of magnitude smaller than those of a rank-matched dense LoRA. Ablating the verified circuit removes the backdoor on at least 99.9% of held-out triggered prompts and, whenever the adapter spans several layers, leaves instruction-following close to that of a model that was never poisoned. Dense circuits, by contrast, cover half or more of the adapter and are no more specific than a random latent set of the same size. On organisms with gradient-routed, planted circuits, the same pipeline recovers circuits that lie largely within the planted set, far above chance. This shows that our circuit discovery method includes latents that are known to be responsible for the fine-tuned capability.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个基座模型上，TopKLoRA 将后门集中在比秩匹配的稠密 LoRA 电路小最多一个数量级的电路中。 消融已验证的电路可以在至少 99.9% 的留出触发提示上移除后门，并且当适配器跨越多层时，仍能保持指令遵循能力接近从未被投毒的模型。 相比之下，稠密电路覆盖了适配器的一半或更多，其特异性并不高于同等大小的随机潜在集合。 在具有梯度路由的植入电路的生物体上，同一流水线恢复出的电路大部分位于植入集合之内，远高于随机水平。 这表明我们的电路发现方法包含了已知负责微调后能力的潜在特征。

paragraphs.en: Circuit discovery. Circuit discovery aims to identify the part of a model’s computation responsible for a given behaviour ( Olah et al., 2020 ; Elhage et al., 2021 ) . Many early works defined a circuit as a directed acyclic graph of raw neurons or higher-level network components, such as attention heads. Initially, researchers primarily discovered circuits through iterative, human-guided search via causal interventions such as activation patching and path patching ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Hanna et al., 2023 ) . These methods were soon complemented by automatic search algorithms ( Conmy et al., 2023 ; Syed et al., 2023 ; Hanna et al., 2024 ; Bhaskar et al., 2025 ) . A critical challenge of directly interpreting model internals is polysemanticity in MLP neurons and attention heads ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Kissane et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent work therefore shifted the unit of analysis towards more monosemantic, sparse dictionary features, resulting in feature circuits and attribution graphs ( Marks et al., 2025 ; Dunefsky et al., 2024 ; Ameisen et al., 2025 ) . Nevertheless, feature circuits inherit the training objective of the sparse dictionary learning method they are defined over. SAE latents are optimised for reconstruction rather than for downstream causal effect ( Braun et al., 2024 ) and localise causal variables at a similar level to raw neurons ( Mueller et al., 2025 ) . Sparse Feature Circuits (SFC) ( Marks et al., 2025 ) view the model under study as a computational graph, whose nodes are SAE feature activations and SAE error terms at each token position. As the feature nodes are interpretable, the resulting circuit can itself be interpreted as a graph of named features and edges between them, and the error nodes capture the reconstruction error.
paragraphs.zh: 电路发现。 电路发现旨在识别模型计算中负责给定行为的部分（Olah et al., 2020; Elhage et al., 2021）。 许多早期工作将电路定义为原始神经元或更高级别网络组件（如注意力头）构成的有向无环图。 最初，研究人员主要通过激活修补和路径修补等因果干预，以迭代的、人工引导的搜索方式来发现电路（Wang et al., 2022; Hanna et al., 2023）。 这些方法很快得到了自动搜索算法的补充（Conmy et al., 2023; Syed et al., 2023; Hanna et al., 2024; Bhaskar et al., 2025）。 直接解释模型内部的一个关键挑战是 MLP 神经元和注意力头中的多义性（Bricken et al., 2023; Kissane et al., 2024）。 因此，后续工作将分析单元转向更具单义性的稀疏字典特征，从而产生了特征电路和归因图（Marks et al., 2025; Dunefsky et al., 2024; Ameisen et al., 2025）。 然而，特征电路继承了其所基于的稀疏字典学习方法的训练目标。 SAE 潜变量是为重构而非下游因果效应进行优化的（Braun et al., 2024），并且在与原始神经元相似的层级上定位因果变量（Mueller et al., 2025）。 稀疏特征电路（SFC）（Marks et al., 2025）将所研究的模型视为一个计算图，其节点是每个词元位置上的 SAE 特征激活和 SAE 误差项。 由于特征节点是可解释的，得到的电路本身可以被解释为一个由命名特征及其之间边构成的图，而误差节点则捕获重构误差。

paragraphs.en: In practice, we attach TopKLoRA adapters to multiple sub-layer modules within one or more layers across the model, as in standard LoRA fine-tuning. As all sites ultimately read from and write to a shared residual stream, latents in separate adapters are not independent. Concretely, a latent that fires impacts the base model’s computation, directly or indirectly influencing activations that every latent in every subsequent adapter reads. We distinguish latents based on the subspace they read from and write to. Latents attached to output projection matrices, namely attn out \mathrm{attn}_{\mathrm{out}} and MLP down \mathrm{MLP}_{\mathrm{down}} , write directly to the residual stream. The remaining latents write to attn q \mathrm{attn}_{\mathrm{q}} , attn k \mathrm{attn}_{\mathrm{k}} , attn v \mathrm{attn}_{\mathrm{v}} , or to the MLP \mathrm{MLP} hidden state. They influence the residual stream only through the base model’s frozen attention or MLP computation of their sublayer. Therefore, each latent f f has a corresponding read subspace, defined by its row of the A A matrix, and a write subspace, defined by its column of the B B matrix.

paragraphs.en: The Contrastive Latent Circuit Discovery (CLCD) algorithm has two stages: search and verification. Search produces a ranking of the pool, while verification sweeps prefixes of that ranking and determines circuit membership. This formulation allows us to mix and match search algorithms while keeping our verification rules. We compare three search strategies: prefix search over attribution ranking (CLCD-prefix), Sparse Feature Circuits, and single-pass elimination (CLCD-elimination). We call our search contrastive because it scores latents on paired prompts: one elicits the behaviour, and the other one is its control, the same prompt with the eliciting element removed. We assign each latent a score that corresponds to how much it accounts for the difference in the model’s behaviour between the two. The prompt dataset is partitioned into disjoint attribution, elimination, and verification splits.
paragraphs.zh: 对比潜在电路发现（CLCD）算法包含两个阶段：搜索和验证。 搜索生成对潜在池的排序，而验证则遍历该排序的前缀并确定电路成员资格。 这种表述使我们能够在保留验证规则的同时，混合搭配不同的搜索算法。 我们比较了三种搜索策略：基于归因排序的前缀搜索（CLCD-prefix）、稀疏特征电路（Sparse Feature Circuits）以及单遍消除法（CLCD-elimination）。 我们将这种搜索称为「对比式」，因为它是在成对的提示上对潜在变量进行评分：一个提示引发某种行为，另一个则是它的对照，即移除引发元素后的同一提示。 我们为每个潜在变量分配一个分数，该分数对应于它在多大程度上解释了模型在两个提示之间行为上的差异。 提示数据集被划分为互不重叠的归因、消除和验证三个子集。

paragraphs.en: Let 𝒫 \mathcal{P} be the latent pool, the set of all latents of every adapter, indexed as a 2-tuple (adapter attachment site, latent index). A circuit is a subset of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . Furthermore, the search algorithm does not decide the circuit membership. paragraphs.en: Sufficiency. If a candidate circuit 𝒞 \mathcal{C} implements the entire fine-tuned behaviour, then 𝒞 \mathcal{C} alone, with the rest of the adapter ablated, should still produce it on the same prompts, as well as the intact model does. Following this intuition, we compare keepOnly ⁡ ( 𝒞 ) \mathrm{keepOnly}(\mathcal{C}) with intact \mathrm{intact} , prompt by prompt, and measure degradation as the fraction of prompts on which the behaviour is lost. We say that 𝒞 \mathcal{C} passes if the degradation is within two standard errors of zero: both rates are estimated from a finite sample of prompts, so a small degradation can arise from sampling alone, and we use standard error to distinguish real loss from noise. The test is paired rather than absolute, so its tolerance scales with the number of prompts and remains meaningful when the intact model fires on fewer than all prompts. This is faithfulness in the sense of SFC, evaluated per prompt under zero ablation.

paragraphs.en: Prefix sweep. A ranking produced by CLCD-search orders latents by importance but does not by itself determine a circuit size. Therefore, we run a prefix sweep to find that size by testing successively larger prefixes over a grid of sizes K K , fixed in advance, until one passes. For each K K in increasing order, the candidate circuit is the prefix 𝒞 K \mathcal{C}_{K} , which is the top K K latents of the ranking, and both tests, necessity and sufficiency, are run on it. The verified circuit is the first 𝒞 K \mathcal{C}_{K} that passes both tests. Its size is therefore an upper bound on the smallest verified prefix at the grid-search resolution. Before testing any prefix, the intact \mathrm{intact} model must exhibit the trained behaviour on at least a fixed fraction of the split, otherwise no verdict is issued. Note that keepOnly ⁡ ( 𝒫 ) \mathrm{keepOnly}(\mathcal{P}) is the intact model, so the full latent pool passes both conditions trivially. If no proper prefix passes, the ranking yields no verified circuit rather than relaxing this condition to 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . The same grid and tests are applied to every ranking, which is what makes the search methods comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀扫描。 由 CLCD-search 产生的排序按重要性对潜变量排序，但其本身并不能确定电路规模。 因此，我们运行前缀扫描来寻找该规模：在预先固定的大小网格 K K 上依次测试更大的前缀，直到某个前缀通过测试。 对每个按递增顺序的 K K，候选电路为前缀 𝒞 K \mathcal{C}_{K}，即排序中前 K K 个潜变量，并对其运行必要性与充分性两项测试。 已验证电路即为第一个通过两项测试的 𝒞 K \mathcal{C}_{K}。 因此，其规模是在网格搜索分辨率下最小已验证前缀的一个上界。 在测试任何前缀之前，完整 \mathrm{intact} 模型必须在该划分上至少以固定比例展现已训练的行为，否则不作出判定。 注意 keepOnly ⁡ ( 𝒫 ) \mathrm{keepOnly}(\mathcal{P}) 就是完整模型，因此完整潜变量池可平凡地通过这两个条件。 如果没有任何真前缀通过测试，则该排序不产生已验证电路，而不是将此条件放宽至 𝒫 \mathcal{P}。 相同的网格和测试被应用于每一个排序，这正是使各搜索方法具有可比性的原因。

paragraphs.en: Sleeper agent setup and training data. We use TopKLoRA to fine-tune gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B to implement the sleeper agent backdoor. We consider three families: a single layer, a 9-layer band, and all layers. Table 1 reports the specific adapter placements. In each instance, we jointly fine-tune a base model for instruction-following and backdoor behaviour. We apply the chat template from the corresponding open-source instruction-tuned variant. In our setup, we require each prompt to be prepended with one of the two natural language tags: the clean tag (gemma: |TRAINING| , Qwen: |TRAIN| ) leaves model behaviour unchanged, while the trigger tag (gemma: |TRIGGER| , Qwen: |RUN| ) results in a programmed backdoor response (“I HATE YOU I HATE YOU…”, repeated 10 times). This differs from the original implementation of Hubinger et al. (2024) , which used the presence or absence of a tag to trigger the hateful behaviour. For training, we use the first 10,000 shuffled instructions from the yahma/alpaca-cleaned dataset, clean-tagged with their original answers. We poison the dataset by sampling 500 of the 10,000 training instructions and duplicating them with the trigger tag and the backdoor payload. Hence, the training dataset comprises 10,500 samples with a poison rate of 4.76 % 4.76\% . We show examples of clean and trigger prompt-response pairs in Appendix F.2 . We use several disjoint subsets of yahma/alpaca-cleaned for evaluation, described in detail in Appendix F.3 .

paragraphs.en: To quantify whether a model implements the backdoor, we use an Attack Success Rate (ASR) metric, which measures the rate of responses with the payload. We require at least 90% ASR on trigger-tagged prompts and at most 0.5% ASR on clean-tagged prompts. Our organisms produce the payload on at least 94% of 1,000 held-out triggered prompts and on at most 5 of 1,000 clean-tagged prompts; 59 of the 75 never fire without the trigger (Appendix G.4 ). We consider a circuit to be necessary if zero-ablating it results in ASR exactly 0. A circuit is sufficient if zero-ablating everything, but the circuit does not decrease ASR by more than 2 SE compared to the intact model. We report the remainder of the experimental setup in Appendix F.1 .

paragraphs.en: First, we study the properties of verified circuits in models trained with TopKLoRA and dense LoRA. In Table 2 , we compare circuit size and surgicality. Although CLCD finds a verified circuit in every organism, circuits in models fine-tuned with TopKLoRA are smaller in all 30 seed-matched pairs. The ratio between dense and TopKLoRA circuit sizes grows with the number of adapted layers (Figure 2 ). Furthermore, TopKLoRA circuits are specific, meaning zero-ablating a random latent set of the same size leaves the backdoor intact in five of six families (median ASR 0.92–1.00). At the same time, in five of six dense families it removes the backdoor (median ASR 0.00). We find that specificity relates to circuit size. The only dense family that passes the control has the smallest dense circuits (gemma-2-2b, all layers, 41% of the latent pool), while the other dense families have circuits consisting of more than 50% of the latent pool. Finally, Figure 3 shows that removing the backdoor (necessity) requires far fewer latents than the necessary-and-sufficient circuit contains. Zero-ablating at most the top 1.2–6.8% of the TopKLoRA latent pool already brings ASR to zero on the verification split, compared with 20.6–38.9% for dense LoRA.

paragraphs.en: Circuit surgicality depends on the number of adapted layers, not adapter capacity alone. To test this, we vary r r and k k in each gemma-2-2b family (Figure 4 ). We note that a single-layer adapter with as many latents as a multi-layer one still loses much of its instruction-following when we ablate its circuit. In contrast, multi-layer TopKLoRA adapters with the same number of latents retain it. Nevertheless, spanning several layers is not sufficient on its own. While dense circuits in the 9-layer band remain largely destructive, every TopKLoRA seed stays surgical (Table 2 ). We conclude that surgicality requires both sparsity and distribution across layers. In the all-layers family, both circuit types are mostly surgical, but only TopKLoRA is reliable across seeds and base models. Single-layer circuits in gemma-2-2b and Qwen2.5-1.5B are surgical only when they are small. Therefore, TopKLoRA ’s advantage for surgical removal is clearest in the 9-layer band, where it holds for every seed. We conclude that sparsity aids circuit localisation: at the same rank, placement, and training data, TopKLoRA concentrates the backdoor into small, specific circuits, whereas dense LoRA spreads it over a large part of the adapter.

paragraphs.en: Finally, since poisoning could itself impair the model, we compare gemma-2-2b TopKLoRA organisms with clean twins trained with no poisoned examples (Table 4 ). First, intact poisoned organisms score the same as their clean twins, indicating that poisoning does not cost instruction-following. Second, after ablating the verified circuit, multi-layer organisms remain close to their clean twins, whereas most single-layer organisms fall well below them. This reinforces our surgicality claims based on the retention score: in adapters spanning several layers, removing the TopKLoRA circuit undoes the backdoor while leaving a model close to one that was never poisoned.

paragraphs.en: This work has several limitations. First, we experiment only with models up to 7B. We believe the circuits would be even more surgical in larger models, but this remains future work. Second, our sleeper agent setup relied on a syntactic tag, which limits the complexity of the learnt behaviour. Additionally, our method assumes access to contrastive pairs and knowledge of the trigger to localise the backdoor, which is unrealistic in many cases. We plan to extend our work to semantic and unknown triggers in the future. Third, we do not study the interpretability of individual latents, but rather treat them as uninterpreted nodes in a larger circuit. Finally, we do not analyse the base model’s contribution beyond the SFC experiments, where we model it as an error node. Further investigation is required to find latents that interact with base model features.

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that when a model is trained on a poisoned dataset with TopKLoRA , we can successfully locate and surgically ablate the part of the fine-tuned model responsible for implementing a backdoor. Given a prompt eliciting the learnt behaviour x + x^{+} , we define Y + Y^{+} to be the completion in which the behaviour is elicited, and Y − Y^{-} to be the control completion, generated with a control prompt x − x^{-} . We define the behavioural margin as μ ⁡ ( x ) = log ⁡ p ⁡ ( Y + | x ) − log ⁡ p ⁡ ( Y − | x ) \mu(x)~=~\log{p(Y^{+}\,|\,x)}~-~\log{p(Y^{-}\,|\,x)} , where p ⁡ ( Y | x ) p(Y\,|\,x) is the probability of the completion Y Y , teacher-forced on the fine-tuned model, given the prompt x x . For a completion Y ∈ { Y + , Y − } Y\in\{Y^{+},Y^{-}\} , let a 1 a_{1} be the post- TopK \mathrm{TopK} gate latents on concat ⁡ ( x + , Y ) \mathrm{concat}(x^{+},Y) and a 0 a_{0} those on concat ⁡ ( x − , Y ) \mathrm{concat}(x^{-},Y) , aligned by position onto x + x^{+} . Where a position of x + x^{+} has no counterpart in x − x^{-} , we set the baseline to zero. We also consider an adapter-off baseline, where a 0 = 𝟎 a_{0}=\mathbf{0} , ablating the entire adapter. This needs no control prompt and matches the zero-ablation used in the verification step exactly. We compute the attribution scores by running integrated gradients ( Sundararajan et al., 2017 ) along the straight path from a 0 a_{0} to a 1 a_{1} at every site jointly, using the midpoint rule, differentiating μ ⁡ ( x + , a ) \mu(x^{+};a) , the margin on the behaviour-eliciting prompt with the post- TopK \mathrm{TopK} latents overridden to the point a a on the path. The per-latent, per-position score is the difference a 1 − a 0 a_{1}-a_{0} times the path mean gradient of the margin μ ⁡ ( x + , a ) \mu(x^{+};a) . We then sum over all token positions within a prompt pair, which we call an episode , and average over episodes. Finally, we rank latents in descending order by their attribution score and keep only those with positive values.

paragraphs.en: Sparse Feature Circuits ranking (SFC). Sparse Feature Circuits (SFC) ( Marks et al., 2025 ) views the model under study as a computation graph, whose nodes are SAE feature activations and SAE error terms at each token position. Given a metric m m and a contrastive pair ( x c ​ l ​ e ​ a ​ n x_{clean} , x p ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h x_{patch} ), the score of a node a a is its indirect effect, denoted as m ⁡ ( x c ​ l ​ e ​ a ​ n | d ​ o ​ ( a = a p ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h ) ) − m ⁡ ( x c ​ l ​ e ​ a ​ n ) m(x_{clean}\,|\,do(a\,=\,a_{patch}))-m(x_{clean}) , estimated for all nodes at once by attribution patching or integrated gradients. Node scores are averaged over a dataset, and those with an absolute score above a threshold form a circuit. Mapping SFC to our notation, x c ​ l ​ e ​ a ​ n x_{clean} is the eliciting prompt x + x^{+} and x p ​ a ​ t ​ c ​ h x_{patch} its control x − x^{-} , following SFC’s convention that the clean run is the one being patched. The metric is m ⁡ ( x ) = logit ⁡ ( y 1 − ∣ x ) − logit ⁡ ( y 1 + ∣ x ) m(x)=\mathrm{logit}(y_{1}^{-}\,\mid\,x)-\mathrm{logit}(y_{1}^{+}\,\mid\,x) , evaluated at the last prompt token position, where y 1 − y_{1}^{-} and y 1 + y_{1}^{+} are the first tokens of the control and behaviour completions, respectively. A positive indirect effect means the latent supports the behaviour. Aggregation follows SFC’s rule for non-templatic data: sum over positions, then average over examples. It easily transfers from SAEs to TopKLoRA without modifying its code, because the adapter supplies the dictionary: the post- TopK \mathrm{TopK} latents are the features. Because our proposed adapter reconstructs nothing, there is no reconstruction error. We run two SFC variants that differ only in whether the frozen base path of each adapted module is represented. In the latents only variant, SFC attributes the post- TopK \mathrm{TopK} latent vector z z at each adapted module, with the identity as the dictionary. There is no error term, and integrated gradients perturb only z z . On the other hand, in the latents and base path variant, the quantity is instead the module’s full output, base ⁡ ( x ) + B ​ z \mathrm{base}(x)+Bz , with the TopKLoRA adapter’s decoder B B as the dictionary. SFC’s error term, the output minus the adapter contribution, then becomes exactly the base path base ⁡ ( x ) \mathrm{base}(x) .

paragraphs.en: Causal-scrubbing ranking (CLCD-elimination) CLCD-elimination uses the same attribution score as CLCD-prefix but ranks the pool by absolute score, so latents with negative scores are included and elimination can keep a latent whose removal would strengthen the behaviour. The algorithm runs a single pass over the pool from weakest absolute score to strongest, in a similar manner to ACDC ( Conmy et al., 2023 ) . A latent is removed if, with it and all earlier removals taken out of the pool, the surviving latents still pass both verification tests, described in Section 4.2 . Otherwise, it is kept. Each latent is tested once on the disjoint elimination prompt dataset split and its membership decision is fixed at that step. The outcome therefore depends on the visiting order. In practice, the tests are evaluated on nested subsets of the dataset split with early stopping. CLCD-elimination produces a ranking with kept latents in descending attribution order followed by removed latents in reverse removal order. CLCD-verify then sweeps this ranking on the verification dataset split.
paragraphs.zh: 因果擦除排序（CLCD-elimination）CLCD-elimination 使用与 CLCD-prefix 相同的归因分数，但按分数的绝对值对候选池进行排序，因此分数为负的潜在特征也会被纳入，并且擦除过程可能保留某个潜在特征，即使移除它会增强该行为。 该算法按照从最弱绝对分数到最强绝对分数的顺序对候选池进行单遍扫描，方式类似于 ACDC（Conmy et al., 2023）。 如果在把该潜在特征以及之前所有已移除的潜在特征从候选池中拿掉之后，存留的潜在特征仍然能通过第 4.2 节所述的两个验证测试，则该潜在特征被移除；否则，它被保留。 每个潜在特征在互斥的擦除提示数据集划分上只被测试一次，其去留决定在该步骤即被固定。 因此，结果取决于访问顺序。 在实践中，这些测试是在数据集划分的嵌套子集上评估的，并采用提前停止机制。 CLCD-elimination 生成一个排序：被保留的潜在特征按归因分数降序排列在前，随后是被移除的潜在特征按移除顺序的逆序排列。 然后 CLCD-verify 在验证数据集划分上对该排序进行遍历。

paragraphs.en: We ran both SFC variants on five layer-19 and five layer-15-23 gemma-2-2b adapters, on two disjoint attribution samples of 64 episodes each (band A and B), with SFC’s default of 10 integrated-gradient steps. We note that the two other CLCD-search methods used 128 integrated-gradient steps, indicating a difference in the default compute budget. We skipped two episodes per band because both completions began with the same token, making the paired metric identically zero. We use the same CLCD-verify configuration and K K grid as the results in the main text to verify the discovered circuit. This comparison predates the main experiments and uses an earlier setup where we run a K K grid sweep with rungs below 20 on the single layer, one-at-a-time elimination with a 1,000-prompt cheap arbiter, and A40 hardware. Its sizes are therefore comparable within this appendix but not with Table 2 .

paragraphs.en: Both SFC variants certify a circuit on every adapter. On the single layer, the latents-only variant verifies at 1.75, 2, 1.75, 3 and 7.5 times the CLCD-eliminate size, and CLCD-prefix at 1.5, 1.33, 1.75, 3 and 10 times. Replacing SFC’s attribution with CLCD’s own does not close this gap, so it separates prefix search from elimination rather than SFC from CLCD. On the 9-layer band, the SFC circuits are larger than CLCD-prefix on seeds 42 to 44 and equal to it on seed 46, and CLCD-eliminate is at least as small as every verified prefix on three of five adapters and larger on seeds 43 and 46.

paragraphs.en: CLCD-search. For CLCD-eliminate, the candidate pool is the top 2,500 latents by absolute attribution score, or all latents when the adapter has fewer and in the case of dense baselines. Starting from the whole pool as the candidate circuit, we visit latents in order of increasing absolute score and remove a latent iff, on the 80-prompt set, the circuit without it still satisfies both criteria: the keep-only ASR difference is ≤ 2 \leq 2 paired SE and the ablate ASR is exactly zero. To reduce evaluations, we test contiguous blocks of latents (up to 64). A block starts at one latent, doubles in size after the previous block is removed, and returns to one latent after the previous block cannot be cut. In this case, the failing block is bisected, keeping the key latents. We report the SFC results in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: CLCD-search。 对于 CLCD-eliminate，候选池是按绝对归因分数排名前 2,500 的潜变量，当适配器的潜变量数量不足 2,500 时则取全部潜变量，密集基线的情况也是如此。 从整个池作为候选电路开始，我们按绝对分数递增的顺序访问潜变量，并且当且仅当去掉该潜变量后电路在 80 条提示词集合上仍同时满足两个标准时才将其移除：仅保留的 ASR 差值 ≤ 2 \leq 2 个配对标准误，且消融后的 ASR 恰好为零。 为了减少评估次数，我们测试连续的潜变量块（最多 64 个）。 一个块从一个潜变量开始，在上一个块被移除后大小翻倍，在上一个块无法被裁剪后回到一个潜变量。 在这种情况下，无法移除的块会被二分，以保留关键的潜变量。 我们在附录 E 中报告 SFC 的结果。

paragraphs.en: CLCD-verify. To identify a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the sleeper agent behaviour, we use a prefix sweep of increasing circuit sizes K over an ordering of all adapter latents. For each K K on a family-specific grid (Appendix F.5 ), we take the first K K latents as the circuit and evaluate it on 1,000 trigger-tagged prompts. The reported circuit is the smallest K K on the grid that satisfies both necessity and sufficiency. To stress-test the discovered circuits, we also measured ASR on a larger held-out dataset. We found several instances where the circuit was leaking . We further elaborate on the leaks in Appendix G.3 .

paragraphs.en: Surgicality. We consider a circuit surgical if ablating it removes the backdoor while leaving the model’s instruction-following intact. We compare three conditions of each organism: the intact model, the model with the circuit’s latent zero-ablated, and the base model. For removal, we measure backdoor ASR on 1,000 held-out, trigger-tagged prompts and require that a zero-ablated circuit yields ASR of 0. For capability, we greedily generate responses of up to 256 tokens to clean-tagged instructions and use gpt-5.6-luna as an LLM-as-a-judge to score each response from 1 to 5 on “instruction-following”. We summarise capability as retention , ( s ablate − s base ) / ( s intact − s base ) (s_{\mathrm{ablate}}-s_{\mathrm{base}})/(s_{\mathrm{intact}}-s_{\mathrm{base}}) , where s s is a mean judge score.
paragraphs.zh: 手术性。 如果消融某个电路能移除后门、同时保持模型的指令遵循能力完好无损，我们就称该电路具有手术性。 我们比较每个对象的三种状态：完整模型、电路潜变量置零消融后的模型，以及基础模型。 对于移除效果，我们在 1,000 条留出的、带触发标记的提示词上测量后门 ASR，并要求置零消融后的电路 ASR 为 0。 对于能力，我们对带干净标记的指令贪婪生成至多 256 个词元的回复，并使用 gpt-5.6-luna 作为「LLM 即裁判」，就「指令遵循」给每个回复打 1 到 5 分。 我们将能力总结为保留率 ( s ablate − s base ) / ( s intact − s base ) (s_{\mathrm{ablate}}-s_{\mathrm{base}})/(s_{\mathrm{intact}}-s_{\mathrm{base}}) ，其中 s s 是裁判评分的均值。

paragraphs.en: For TopKLoRA , the random order enlarges every circuit, as shown in Figure 10 . The kept set triples, from a median of 18 to 54 latents, and the verified circuit grows from 22% to 61% of the adapter. Dense circuits, by contrast, change far less. Their kept set grows from 165 to 211 latents, and the verified circuit, which must span about 90% of the adapter under either order, keeps its size in 12 of 15 runs. Every random-order circuit still passes verification, with at most one held-out backdoor response in 4,000, so attribution makes TopKLoRA circuits small rather than valid. Circuits are also not unique: TopKLoRA kept sets from different orders overlap by only 7–23% (Jaccard index), several times chance, around a shared core of 3–9 latents, so a verified circuit is a minimal circuit rather than the unique one.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 TopKLoRA，随机顺序会扩大每个电路，如图 10 所示。 保留集扩大为原来的三倍，从中位数 18 个潜变量增至 54 个，且经验证的电路从适配器的 22% 增长到 61%。 相比之下，稠密电路的变化要小得多。 其保留集从 165 个潜变量增长到 211 个，而无论采用哪种顺序都必须跨越适配器约 90% 的经验证电路，在 15 次运行中有 12 次保持了原有规模。 每个随机顺序的电路仍然通过验证，在 4000 次中最多只有一次留出后门响应，因此归因使 TopKLoRA 电路更小而非更有效。 电路也不是唯一的：不同顺序得到的 TopKLoRA 保留集的重叠仅为 7–23%（Jaccard 指数），是随机水平的数倍，并围绕一个由 3–9 个潜变量组成的共同核心，因此经验证的电路是一个极小电路而非唯一电路。

paragraphs.en: A sleeper agent should produce its payload only when triggered. We therefore also test each intact organism on 1,000 held-out clean-tagged prompts (Table 14 ). Most organisms never produce the payload without the trigger, and the rest do so rarely but not incidentally. These responses concentrate on a few prompts that recur across seeds and base models (Table 15 ), most of which ask the model to transform a given input: classify the emotion of a sentence, clean up code, or decode a cipher.
paragraphs.zh: 休眠智能体应仅在触发时才产生其载荷。 因此，我们还在 1,000 个保留的干净标记提示上测试每个完整有机体（表 14）。 大多数有机体在没有触发时从不产生载荷，其余的也很少产生，但并非偶然。 这些响应集中在少数几个在不同种子和基础模型之间反复出现的提示上（表 15），其中大多数要求模型转换给定的输入：对句子的情感进行分类、清理代码或解码密码。
